basic_info.description: The best of San Francisco unfolds in tints of misty blue just outside the door of this 18-unit apartment building that is yours to claim as the crown jewel of your investment portfolio. Standing tall on a corner lot in Lower Pacific Heights, the building is just one block from the delights of Lafayette Park: tennis courts, a playground, a dog play area, and walking trails. Beyond, the gentle waves of San Francisco Bay glide through East Harbor and lap softly against the sides of Pier 2 and the verdant grounds of a Golden Gate National Recreation Area. Your lucky tenants can gather with friends around the fire pit on the grassy rooftop patio, gazing out at the pulsating city life around them. People travel from all over the world to visit destinations like Lombard Street and Pier 39. Here is a property that places its residents in the center of it all, walking distance from every form of cultural enrichment and artistic wonderment. Bear witness to architectural marvels of the 20th century, recalling all of the legendary people who have lived, worked, dreamed, and made their mark in this inimitable city. Now it is your turn. Each unit has been well maintained, and all city-required seismic retrofitting has been done. Financials are available upon request. Time to make your move.
